scientific_integrity: Exact algebraic proof with symbolic and rational replay; finite numerical tests are not universal certificates. Prior originating algorithm, order conditions and broad oscillation observations acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Local equilibrium spectral convergence for symmetric two-component exchange, constant exact steps and MPE-embedded two-step MPLM only. No global convergence, arbitrary network, or publication priority assertion.
title: Unique fastest step and stiff-limit slowdown of a two-step Patankar multistep integrator
